what: Pressing the 25em pill floating at top center of the screen (logo + two-line button) first widens the pill to the stage width over .5s, then .25s later the panel below unfolds over .75s (grid-rows), and the two columns inside rise from 2em below over .75s, delayed by .5s and .575s. The backdrop fades in over .5s and the two lines become a ±45° X. On closing, the panel folds first over .5s, and .2s later the width narrows over .75s. Hovering a link lights up the photo with the same key, from 1.1 → 1

options.--fx-dur · --fx-dur-long · --fx-ease: Short and long durations and curve (css), default .5s · .75s · cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1)
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open/close button (required) — inside <i> With two, the line becomes X
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel that unfolds downward (its first child only)
options.[data-fx-part=link] · [data-fx-part=visu: (If any) Link and photo pair sharing the same data-key
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (If any) Back curtain — click to close

note: State is a single data-nav-state (open/closed) — fires fx:open and fx:close on open and close. Scroll lock is applied by the consumer on those events (the original uses Lenis stop/start)

from.where: shared.js NAV · shared.css .rh-nav — original twostep-nav: bar max-width 25em→100% (.5s, when closing .75s with a .2s delay), bottom grid-rows .75s with a .25s delay, cells 2em .75s .5s·.575s, cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1)

All-section menu (shared.js .tsn) — 25em pill, .5s width → panel .75s (grid-rows) after .25s, cells rise 2em from below .5 · .575s later over .75s, two lines ±45°, curve cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1) exactly as the original
